svg.title: For any ordered list of distinct nonsingleton current groups with no preassigned shells, one can resolve their shells successively. The common bound becomes a constant times Q j 2−njγ. This is summable over the Cartesian product of all shell indices. Repeated use of (CE12) and absolute Fubini therefore gives the full iterated sum, equal to the original integral. In particular every permitted resolution order gives that same pairing. This does not assert absolute convergence of
